package module

import (
	"context"

	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/domain/repository"
	"github.com/example/mc-course-service/internal/filters"
)

// GetModule returns a module.
type GetModule struct {
	Modules    repository.ModuleRepository
	ModuleI18n repository.ModuleI18nRepository
}

func (uc GetModule) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) (*domain.Module, []domain.ModuleI18n, error) {
	item, err := uc.Modules.Get(ctx, id)
	if err != nil {
		return nil, nil, err
	}
	var translations []domain.ModuleI18n
	if uc.ModuleI18n != nil {
		translations, err = uc.ModuleI18n.ListByModule(ctx, id)
		if err != nil {
			return nil, nil, err
		}
	}
	return item, translations, nil
}

// ListModulesInput controls module list scope.
type ListModulesInput struct {
	CourseID   string
	Scope      string
	TechID     *int
	ActiveOnly bool
}

// ListModules lists modules by course or all reusable modules.
type ListModules struct {
	Modules repository.ModuleRepository
	Courses repository.CourseRepository
}

func (uc ListModules) Handle(ctx context.Context, in ListModulesInput) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	if in.CourseID != "" {
		if uc.Courses != nil {
			if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, in.CourseID); err != nil {
				return nil, err
			}
		}
	}
	if in.CourseID == "" && !isValidModuleScope(in.Scope) {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}

	scope := in.Scope
	if in.CourseID != "" {
		scope = ""
	}
	return uc.Modules.List(ctx, filters.ModuleFilters{
		CourseID:   in.CourseID,
		Scope:      scope,
		TechID:     in.TechID,
		ActiveOnly: in.ActiveOnly,
	})
}

func isValidModuleScope(scope string) bool {
	switch scope {
	case "", "all", "content", "independent", "standalone", "course_only", "both", "internal":
		return true
	default:
		return false
	}
}

// ListModulesByCourse lists modules for a course.
//
// Deprecated: use ListModules with CourseID instead.
type ListModulesByCourse struct {
	ListModules
}

func (uc ListModulesByCourse) Handle(ctx context.Context, courseID string) ([]domain.Module, error) {
	if courseID == "" {
		return nil, domain.ErrValidation
	}
	if uc.Modules != nil {
		return uc.ListModules.Handle(ctx, ListModulesInput{CourseID: courseID})
	}
	if uc.Courses != nil {
		if _, err := uc.Courses.GetByID(ctx, courseID); err != nil {
			return nil, err
		}
	}
	return uc.Modules.ListByCourse(ctx, courseID)
}

// DeleteModule marks a module inactive.
type DeleteModule struct {
	Modules repository.ModuleRepository
}

func (uc DeleteModule) Handle(ctx context.Context, id string) error {
	if id == "" {
		return domain.ErrValidation
	}
	return uc.Modules.Delete(ctx, id)
}
